scope: Action target preparation across eighteen pool, selection and mask modes.

validation.case_scope: One focused fixture covers all18 modes, mode1 property override and fallback, pool random tags78 through83, selected-list copying, side-dependent target modes, mode15 resource filtering, mode16 mask-to-random fallthrough, empty-pool failure and out-of-range mode. Three affected opcode/execution fixtures pass through the recovered chain. Mode3 retains its original unchecked empty-pool random call and mode17 retains retry-until-not-self; these pathological paths are not runtime validated. Native gameplay is unvalidated. Logical/ABI recovery only, not Full72, bitwise FP or gameplay proof.
validation.target_property_composition: Target filtering and preparation now compose resource property lookup, mask indexing and the narrower target-unavailability predicate. Fixtures use actual property masks and payload indexes instead of mocked predicates; readiness, adjustment, preparation, target and marshaling checks pass. Random selection and preferred-target selection remain pending composition steps; native gameplay is unvalidated.
validation.preferred_target_composition: Preparation now composes battle_preferred_target61 instead of a preferred-target stub. The source property override and preferred pool path both pass with real logical selection.
validation.random_chain_composition: Preparation, target filtering/refinement, skill picking and item selection now compose the recovered random-range helper. Five focused fixtures pass using actual per-group/per-tag cursors and controlled synthetic table values instead of random-service stubs, including self-target retry and equal-range no-advance behavior. Four existing record/execution/effect fixtures also pass with the shared synthetic random table. Native random-table data, statistical behavior and gameplay remain unvalidated.
